name: Tianjin signalised intersection (SinD 8_2_1)

source.dataset: SinD: a drone dataset at a signalised intersection in Tianjin, China (SOTIF-AVLab, Tsinghua University); record 8_2_1 sample
source.licence: CC0 1.0 as modified by the authors: not permitted for commercial purposes (non-commercial research and display only)
source.citation: Xu, Y., Shao, W., Li, J., Yang, K., Wang, W., Huang, H., Lv, C., Wang, H. (2022). SIND: A Drone Dataset at Signalized Intersection in China. IEEE ITSC 2022, 2471-2478. doi:10.1109/ITSC55140.2022.9921959
source.processing: site feed -> m, front-bumper reference, local plane (+y main road); Savitzky-Golay (15 frames, order 2) on x/y, v and a from smoothed derivatives; gaps <= 0.5 s interpolated

axes: local metres; +y along the main road, +x across; vehicle point = front-bumper centre, pedestrian point = body centre
